groupings.title: Getting started
groupings.description: Connect the Scenario MCP server and learn the core generation loop every other skill builds on.

groupings.title: Finding a direction
groupings.description: Turn a blank brief into references, options someone can choose between, and a moodboard the next batch runs from.

groupings.title: Images
groupings.description: Generate and edit images: model choice, sizing, references, masked edits, post-processing tools, and letter-perfect text overlay cards.

groupings.title: Game art and environments
groupings.description: Sprites, icons, tilesets, textures, skyboxes, and 3D assets ready for game engines.

groupings.title: Video and audio
groupings.description: Video generation and editing, music, sound effects, voice, and speech.

groupings.title: Consistency and custom models
groupings.description: Hold one character, product, or style across a whole set, and train custom models on your own art.

groupings.title: Reviewing and organizing output
groupings.description: Read finished assets back: caption them, extract a style or a control map, check a batch against a brief or the Quality Gate, compare candidate models on one brief, and file the keepers.

groupings.title: Formats and placements
groupings.description: Ship one approved master, image or video, to every placement: ratios, safe zones, and platform specs from social feeds to shops, storefronts, and print.

groupings.title: Workflows and apps
groupings.description: Discover, run, build, and publish Scenario workflows (apps), and migrate graphs from Weavy, ComfyUI, or other node editors.

groupings.title: Troubleshooting
groupings.description: Get past a blocked generation, and turn a stuck session into a reproducible public issue.

groupings.title: Team administration
groupings.description: Govern a team from the agent: which models it can run, who is on it and in which projects, per-member spend caps, API key roles, and who spent what.

groupings.title: Image model families
groupings.description: The top image families in depth: generation and editing modes, reference rules, and the caps that differ per member.

groupings.title: Video model families
groupings.description: The top video families in depth: conditioning modes, native audio, editing and extension, and per-member caps and costs.

groupings.title: Audio model families
groupings.description: The top audio families in depth: music, covers and stems, sound effects, speech, dubbing, and video scoring.

groupings.title: 3D model families
groupings.description: The top 3D families in depth: mesh generation, retexture and rigging toolchains, portraits, and explorable worlds and splats.

groupings.title: Expert tools: ZBrush
groupings.description: DCC software. A lead and eight specialists that drive Maxon ZBrush 2026 through its agent bridge: sculpting, characters and creatures, stylized work, hard surface, polypaint and renders, posing and 3D print, retopology and export, automation. The bridge was proven live; full live tests of every skill are still pending.

groupings.title: Expert tools: Blender
groupings.description: DCC software. A lead and twelve specialists that drive Blender 5.2 through Python, headless or in a live session: sculpting, retopology, UVs and baking, shading, hair, rigging, animation, previs, Geometry Nodes, lighting, Grease Pencil, hard surface. Test suites pass headless on Blender 5.2.1.

groupings.title: Expert tools: Maya
groupings.description: DCC software. A lead and ten specialists that drive Autodesk Maya 2027 through Python, batch or live: modeling, retopology and UVs, rigging, skinning, animation, groom, FX, look dev, Arnold lighting and rendering, pipeline scripting. Tested offline only; not yet run inside Maya.

groupings.title: Expert tools: Unreal Engine
groupings.description: Game engine. A lead and nine specialists that drive Unreal Engine 5.8 on macOS through Editor Python, headless jobs, and Epic's Unreal MCP server: world building, materials, lighting and rendering, gameplay, animation, cinematics, VFX, pipeline automation, performance. Tested offline only; not yet run inside the engine.

groupings.title: Expert tools: Unity
groupings.description: Game engine. A lead and thirteen specialists that drive Unity 6.3 LTS on macOS through batch mode, a live editor, and command-line builds: architecture, gameplay, 2D, animation, UI, VFX, shaders, rendering and lighting, world building, performance, mobile, Web, pipeline automation. Every procedure was run live in Unity 6.3.
